18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

2159-progress.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-progress.text: How might I be of service to you, young one?  Are you here to rest in the inn?  Do you require a hearthstone?
2159-progress.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

2438-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-progress.text:
Please move swiftly. I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

Have you recovered it yet, $N?
2438-progress.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2459-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-progress.text: Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine mystics must return what is mine.  Please retrieve the emerald so that I may repair my emerald dreamcatcher.
2459-progress.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

308-progress.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-progress.text: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!
308-progress.title: Distracting Jarven

310-progress.name: Unguarded Thunder Ale Barrel
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

3112-progress.name: Thran Khorman
3112-progress.text:
Ah, well, another memorandum from a $r on a mission... isn't this quaint.

No, no, I ain't teasin' ya, little one. Gotta respect your tenacity, that much is fer sure. I'd be just as peeved if Ironforge was taken by Dark Iron dwarves, so don't be thinkin' I don't feel for your plight...
3112-progress.title: Simple Memorandum

313-progress.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-progress.text: Hey, $N.  Been to the Grizzled Den yet?  Those Wendigos can be fierce.
313-progress.title: The Grizzled Den

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

317-progress.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-progress.text: Preparations are going well.  How goes your hunting?
317-progress.title: Stocking Jetsteam

319-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-progress.text: Have you taken care of those wild animals?
319-progress.title: A Favor for Evershine

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

400-progress.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-progress.text:
Hm?  You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot.  But no matter...do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?
400-progress.title: Tools for Steelgrill

412-progress.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-progress.text: The Recombobulator will be up and running as soon as we have sufficient Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.
412-progress.title: Operation Recombobulation

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

432-progress.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-progress.text: It makes me so mad! Grrr...
432-progress.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

433-progress.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-progress.text: If we can remove the troggs from Gol'Bolar quarry, it will be the first step of many that we will have to undertake to rid ourselves of this menace.
433-progress.title: The Public Servant

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

487-progress.name: Moon Priestess Amara
487-progress.text: The road is still not safe, $c. Travel forth and slay 6 Gnarlpine Ambushers and return to me.
487-progress.title: The Road to Darnassus

488-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-progress.text: Have you been a busy little bee, $N?  I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.
488-progress.title: Zenn's Bidding

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

490-progress.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-progress.text: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
490-progress.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

5541-progress.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-progress.text: I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
5541-progress.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

928-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-progress.text: Greetings, $c. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
928-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

96606-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96606-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96606-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96630-progress.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96630-progress.title: The Adventurer

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

97942-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97942-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97942-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97942-complete.name: Byancie
97942-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97942-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97948-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97948-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97948-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

98067-progress.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-progress.text: We must remain vigilant, for though Darnassus is well-protected our enemies are everywhere.
98067-progress.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98319-accept.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98319-accept.text:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.
98319-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98326-complete.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-complete.text:
Yer a real lifesaver, $N!

My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bear tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
98326-complete.title: Frosthowl

98326-progress.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-progress.text: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
98326-progress.title: Frosthowl

99158-accept.name: Maxan Anvol
99158-accept.text:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?
99158-accept.title: Dawn in the Mountains
